title: Aromatic Crispy Russian Potato Dumplings
description: Garlicky and crispy Russian potato dumplings infused with mustard seeds and nut-free-friendly ingredients, perfect for a hangover cure. This dish features a unique blend of flavors and textures.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine grated potatoes, chopped onion, minced garlic, mustard seeds, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Add the infuse oil to the potato mixture and stir until everything is well combined.
Gradually add the flour to the potato mixture, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together.
Add the beaten egg to the dough and mix until a sticky ball forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for about 5 minutes, until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and heat a non-stick skillet with a small amount of oil over medium heat.
Cook the dumplings in batches until they are crispy and golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Serve the dumplings hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
